To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) a nested logit specification is a useful model of the choice among space heat and water heating technologies; (2) the model is sensitive to the specification of the choice among fuels for space heat, but the choice among water heating technologies is relatively insensitive to specification; (3) the model is relatively insensitive to the inclusion of the price of energy in the utility bill; (4) the model is insensitive to the inclusion or exclusion of the price of the appliance; and (5)

(1) energy conservation measures (ECM's) have a positive effect on the probability of selecting an energy efficient appliance, (2) the effect of an ECM on the probability of purchasing an energy efficient appliance is greater for the more energy efficient appliance, and (3) the effect of a given ECM is greater for appliances that have a greater energy savings potential.

(i) The nested logit model of space heat and water heater choice provides good predictions of the data; and (ii) The model indicates that the energy conservation standards proposed for space heat and hot water heaters would have a significant impact on the choice of appliances, and that these standards are likely to be more effective in promoting energy efficiency if they are mandatory rather than voluntary.
